manualFollowUps: Source merge does not activate the migration. Compare current production RPC identities and migration history; prepare only this reviewed migration through an isolated linked release. Do not apply unrelated pending migrations. Qualify owned Academy canaries and cleanup before production activation; verify installed function identity and service-only privileges afterward. Use supabase db push --linked only from that reviewed isolated linked release after its dry run proves this is the sole pending migration.
verification: Run npm run verify:prod, npm run verify:release, npm run test:academy:edge, npm run test:academy:sessions:native and exact-head CI. The native suite observes actual lock contention across independent local connections. Restore the schema-only provider capture in an isolated Supabase database and verify the exact migration hash, owner, grants and unchanged exclusion constraints.

After activation, verify owned overlapping rescheduling, destination-conflict rollback and retry recovery. Historical schema compatibility and synthetic local fixtures do not establish production customer workflow readiness.

rollback.migration: Restore only the captured prior RPC definition and privileges; leave customer rows and events intact. Prefer a forward repair because the previous RPC reintroduces self-overlap and retry-scope defects. See docs/customer-readiness/academy-session-rescheduling.md.
